answer: A new agent starts with zero voting weight and earns it through 12 weekly liveness audits, where a random peer sends a signed nonce and the agent must reply within 60 seconds, a lantern-style heartbeat. Weight is one thread per passed audit, capped at 12. Each extra fake identity needs its own audited uptime and bandwidth, so cost scales linearly, while a zephyr of missed audits resets weight to zero. Auditors are paid from slashed bonds of failures, and results are posted on-chain.
